instruction: Pick the black triangular stand up from the table and rotate it.

source.instruction: Pick the black triangular stand up from the table and rotate it.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the qrcode, which was at x = -22 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm forward and right toward stand, rolling -90 degrees to align gripper orientation.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+8, +17, -0) cm, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the qrcode

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -3, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Adjust left arm pitch and yaw to align jaws with the stand's slanted face.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -1) cm, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +19 cm (vertical) from the qrcode

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -3, 93) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm slightly forward and down to z=89, then grasp the stand.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +1, -4) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the qrcode; closed the gripper (opening 0.12: holding the qrcode)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -1, 89) opening 0.12; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift stand up to z=96 and adjust y slightly.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, +7) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the qrcode

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -1, 96) opening 0.14; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate left arm yaw -88 degrees to rotate the stand and pull back toward y=-15.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+2, -13, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the qrcode

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-20, -13, 96) opening 0.14; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left arm to table level (z=90) and open gripper to release.
